# TikTok Downloader

> TikTok Downloader is a free, open-source web tool that turns a TikTok share link into a downloadable video. No account or app install is required.

## Usage

Paste a TikTok share URL (for example `https://vm.tiktok.com/...` or `https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/...`) into the input on the homepage. The video is resolved and saved directly in the browser.

## Direct links

A TikTok URL can also be passed as a path. Opening one of these starts the download immediately:

- `https://tt.fomevod.bid/vm.tiktok.com/ZN8SyMfnP` — short share link
- `https://tt.fomevod.bid/www.tiktok.com/@user/video/123` — full video URL
- `https://tt.fomevod.bid/@user/video/123` — video URL without the domain
- `https://tt.fomevod.bid/ZN8SyMfnP` — bare short code, resolved via `vm.tiktok.com`
- `https://tt.fomevod.bid/https://vm.tiktok.com/ZN8SyMfnP` — scheme included; redirects once before loading
